bear.last: BE: Shorting BE at $191.83 is a low-conviction trap because the stock has already fallen 33.55% over 20 days, leaving little room for further downside before hitting the 52-week low of $75.70 or triggering a violent short squeeze. The Kronos forecast shows only a 50% probability of a down move with a median expected move of just 2.19%, indicating the market has already priced in the immediate post-earnings panic. With an implied volatility of 84% and an ATR of 10.57%, the cost of capital for a short position is punishingly high, and the 1-ATR stop at $212.11 offers a poor risk-reward ratio of roughly 1:1.5 against a target of $172.59.
